description: Voice mode: a new message from the user cuts off the answer being spoken or still waiting to be spoken, and a reply that was never spoken is sent back to be spoken.

hooks.command: state="$(getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR 2>/dev/null || echo /tmp/)"; kill "$(cat "${state}voice-speak.pid" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; killall say 2>/dev/null; exit 0
